title: On Erdős--Ko--Rado and Hilton--Milner Theorems for Direct Products
summary: We investigate $t$-intersecting families in direct-product set systems obtained by prescribing the number of selected elements in each part of a partitioned ground set. For a finite union of layers, we prove an Erdős--Ko--Rado result under coordinatewise linear part-size conditions. As an application, we establish a new range of parameters for which a conjecture of Frankl et al.\ [\emph{J. Combin. Theory Ser. A} \textbf{155} (2018), 493--502] holds.
